'''H-90''' was a sector of the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
Ten years after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], this sector faced a large increase in insurgents while [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] made his bid for [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] independence. During this bid, the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] began arrests of vandals who painted anti-[[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] symbols on government buildings in the sector. A riot nearly broke out, but the assailants were arrested by the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]].
